title: ActionRecord
description: One action in the distributed action protocol (spec section 7, Appendix D `actions`). The Body rejects an action whose life_id is dead, whose body_generation is stale, whose snapshot_revision is older than the allowed window, or whose expires_tick has passed. state moves accepted -> running -> completed | failed | cancelled, each a durable record. Every action ends with one final receipt (committed or aborted); economic kinds (offer, give, write_book, read_book) first write a prepared receipt. See receipt.schema.json and decision 0020.

intent_id.description: The intent this action belongs to. Null for a thought's immediate actions, which have no intent.

body_generation.description: Increments on each Body restart. A record with a stale generation never executes.

sequence.description: Order of this action within its intent.

snapshot_revision.description: The snapshot revision the plan was made from. The Body compares it with its current revision (spec 5.3.2).

kind.description: The action's `do` verb, for example goto, mine, offer.

args.description: Arguments for the verb. Shape depends on kind.

result.description: Outcome detail once the action ends, or null while it has none.

receipt_id.description: The final (committed or aborted) receipt, or null until the action ends.
